acceptanceCriteria: Packages that exec a built corvint binary are either selected on cmd/corvint changes (via a declared edge) or the plan names them as an explicit unknown.
A maintained affected fixture covers the case.
body: A change to cmd/corvint/help.go made `corvint affected` select cmd/corvint (scope UNKNOWN) but not conformance/host-lifecycle-v1 or release-artifact-v0, whose tests build and exec the corvint binary and read root help. No import edge exists, so the selection is incomplete without saying so. Found by the V1-0945 lane, 2026-10-07, base 0b5096ca (branch claude/v1-0945-help-verb-list). Versions: corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360); corvint-tasks build 202.
